description: The old Entra record in rg-{prefix}-entra is deleted only after the registration's deployment into its environment's records group succeeded (ADR-0063).

patches.find:
prov_arm create entra "$inputs" "$entra_name" "$entra_rg" "$PROV_DIR/deployment.json"
  if [ "$target" = environment ]; then retire_instance_record "$app_env"; fi
patches.replace:
if [ "$target" = environment ]; then retire_instance_record "$app_env"; fi
  prov_arm create entra "$inputs" "$entra_name" "$entra_rg" "$PROV_DIR/deployment.json"
